paragraphs.notes: Marker only. This paragraph carries no prose; its entire content is the structural formula drawn immediately below it (drawing 1). The step heading that this structure belongs to is not printed on this page.

paragraphs.zh: 在装有干燥管的反应瓶中加入2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸3-氧代-1-环己烯酯198g(0.5mol)，0.2g氰基丙酮和三乙胺60.6(0.6mol)溶于500ml乙腈溶剂中，反应物在室温持续搅拌24h。蒸除溶剂，加入200ml水和36％的盐酸50ml。用乙酸乙酯萃取，水洗，无水硫酸镁干燥，浓缩得米黄色固体188g，收率95％，熔点120-123℃。
paragraphs.en: Into a reaction flask fitted with a drying tube were charged 198 g (0.5 mol) of 3-oxo-1-cyclohexen-1-yl 2-chloro-3-((2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl)-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate, 0.2 g of cyanoacetone and 60.6 (0.6 mol) of triethylamine, dissolved in 500 ml of acetonitrile solvent; the reaction mixture was stirred continuously at room temperature for 24 h. The solvent was distilled off, and 200 ml of water and 50 ml of 36% hydrochloric acid were added. Extraction with ethyl acetate, washing with water, drying over anhydrous magnesium sulfate and concentration gave 188 g of a beige (rice-yellow) solid, yield 95%, melting point 120-123 degrees C.
paragraphs.notes: 1) The triethylamine charge is printed as '三乙胺60.6(0.6mol)' with NO mass unit after 60.6. The unit is missing in the original; 60.6 g is consistent with 0.6 mol of triethylamine (MW 101.19) but the letter 'g' is genuinely not printed. Transcribed as printed. 2) The catalyst is printed as '氰基丙酮' (cyanoacetone), verified at 8x magnification character by character. Translated literally. Note only that the reagent conventionally used to catalyse this enol-ester to C-acyl rearrangement is acetone cyanohydrin (丙酮氰醇); the page does not say that, and no substitution has been made. 3) Unit letters: this scan's serif face renders lowercase 'l' and the digit '1' with near-identical glyphs (the 'l' of 'mol' is pixel-for-pixel similar to the '1' of '198'). 'mol' and 'ml' were read as the letter l. No digit was altered. 4) Full-width vs half-width punctuation cannot be resolved reliably from the scan. Chinese sentence punctuation is transcribed full-width (，。％) and punctuation inside Latin/numeric runs half-width ( ( ) , - ), per the printed convention of a Chinese patent description. 5) '36％的盐酸50ml' means 50 ml of 36% hydrochloric acid; the concentration precedes the reagent and the volume follows it, as printed.

Printed as 'NMR(CDC13)' because the lowercase 'l' of CDCl3 is rendered with the same glyph as the digit 1 in this face; read as CDCl3. The '3' of CDCl3 is set full size, not subscripted, as printed. No nucleus (1H) and no field strength are given. Shift values, multiplicities and proton counts are transcribed exactly as printed, including the two-significant-figure '2.8'. Total reported protons: 2+2+2+3+2+2+1+1 = 15.

structures.core: Two rings in one molecule: a cyclohexane-1,3-dione (left, drawn fully saturated with no ring double bond and no enol OH) joined at its C2 through a ketone (C=O) bridge to a benzene ring (right).
substituents: cyclohexanedione ring, =O at C1 (double bond drawn straight up from the top vertex to a capital O)
cyclohexanedione ring, =O at C3 (double bond drawn down-right from the lower-right vertex to a capital O)
cyclohexanedione ring, aroyl group C(=O)Ar at C2 (the ring vertex sitting between the two carbonyl-bearing vertices; bond drawn up-right to the bridging carbonyl carbon)
cyclohexanedione ring C4, C5, C6 drawn as bare vertices (CH2); no ring C=C is drawn anywhere in this ring
bridging carbonyl carbon bears =O drawn straight up to a capital O, and bonds down-left to cyclohexanedione C2 and down-right to benzene C1
benzene ring, C(=O) bridge at C1 (ipso; the upper-left vertex of the hexagon)
Cl at C2 (benzene top vertex, the vertex adjacent to ipso going clockwise)
CH2OCH2CF3 at C3 (benzene upper-right vertex; label written out in full to the right of the ring)
SO2CH3 at C4 (benzene lower-right vertex; label written out in full to the lower right)
H at C5 (benzene bottom vertex) and H at C6 (benzene lower-left vertex); both drawn bare
benzene Kekule double bonds drawn as inner lines on C1=C2, C3=C4 and C5=C6
structures.name: 2-[2-chloro-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoyl]cyclohexane-1,3-dione

drawings.notes: Single standalone structure, no arrow and no reagent labels. It is the product of the reaction described in [0060] immediately below it, i.e. the final compound of the invention's route, not an intermediate and not prior art. Ring positions were read off the drawing geometry (hexagon with two vertical sides; attachment at the upper-left vertex, then clockwise Cl, CH2OCH2CF3, SO2CH3) and only afterwards compared with the compound name in [0060]; they agree. The left ring is drawn in the diketo (2-acyl-1,3-dione) tautomer: no OH and no ring C=C is drawn, so C2 carries one implicit H as drawn. Molecular formula of the drawn structure C17H16ClF3O6S, MW 440.82.

discrepancies.what: The masses and moles in [0060] are arithmetically inconsistent with the molecular weight of the structure drawn at [0059]. Both the substrate charge and the product yield imply a molecular weight of about 396, whereas the drawn structure is 440.82.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Drawn product is C17H16ClF3O6S, MW 440.82. The substrate named in the text is its enol-ester isomer, so it has the same MW. 0.5 mol of substrate would be 220.4 g, and a 95% yield of product from 0.5 mol would be 209.4 g.
discrepancies.text_says: '198g(0.5mol)' of substrate, which implies MW 396. '浓缩得米黄色固体188g，收率95％' from 0.5 mol, which implies MW 395.8 (188 / (0.5 x 0.95)). Against the drawn MW of 440.82 the true yield from 198 g would be about 85%, and 188 g is 85.3% of the 220.4 g theoretical. The triethylamine figure (60.6 for 0.6 mol, MW 101.19) is internally correct, so the inconsistency is confined to the substrate and product.

discrepancies.what: The proton count reported in [0061] fits the enol tautomer, while [0059] draws the diketo tautomer. Recorded as an observation only; the drawing has not been reinterpreted.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Diketo form: C2 of the cyclohexane-1,3-dione bears one implicit H, and the three remaining ring carbons are CH2 (6H), which would give 16 reported protons in total including the C2-H.
discrepancies.text_says: [0061] reports 15 protons with three 2H multiplets at 2.05, 2.45 and 2.8 (three CH2) and no separate 1H signal for a C2-H; the missing proton is consistent with an exchangeable enol OH that was not reported.

discrepancies.what: Cyanoacetone is written in the text but no catalyst, reagent or condition appears anywhere in the drawing.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Nothing. The drawing is a lone product structure with no arrow, no reagents above or below, and no conditions.
discrepancies.text_says: 0.2 g 氰基丙酮 (cyanoacetone) as catalyst, triethylamine 60.6 (0.6 mol) as base, 500 ml acetonitrile as solvent, room temperature, 24 h.
